meta.title: Type evaluation results depend on evaluation ordering
meta.fix_ref: none named (maintainer: 'This is addressed in pyright 1.1.200')
meta.build_notes: npm pyright@1.1.199 (2021-12-22) and pyright@1.1.200 (2021-12-25); release window from the maintainer's comment.
meta.notes: Tracking bug of microsoft/pylance-release#2192; same pattern as the pilot case pyright-2983 (race timing: a hover right after the edit, before the server re-analyses).

settings_note: The file sets strict mode itself ('# pyright: strict'); no other settings are named.

files.note: the '# pyright: strict' comment is part of the issue's code

repro.steps: Open main.py and let the server analyze it. Modify the file (add a space at the end of the last line) and hover the 'initial' identifier immediately afterwards, before the server re-analyzes the file. Reported: types are then evaluated as unknown, which produces errors in strict mode; without the hover no unknowns are produced. After the server settles, the diagnostics of main.py and the hovers on lst and initial must equal those of a fresh session on the same final text.
